title: Eiffel Tower Skip the Line and Small Group Tour with Summit Access by Elevator
description: Queues for the Eiffel Tower can take over an hour at busy times but this skip-the-line tour lets you breeze past the crowds and enjoy priority access. Head straight up to the second floor and listen as your guide points out the Louvre, the Arc de Triomphe, and Notre Dame Cathedral. Finally, continue to the top floor on your own, where you can spend as long as you like admiring the views.

reviews.usertext:
We met our guide at the designated place to receive our official ticket.
The skip the line is a little deceiving as you still have to go through security, twice.
Our guide Michael a nice young student, could have spoken much louder and faced us while telling us his important facts! Also not good at keeping the group together. He started the tour by telling us “we were going on the Eiffel Tower to see the Sunrise!”
We never got to the summit as it was closed!
Once the tour ended it was very confusing to even access the elevators and signs had been turned so we didn’t know where we were supposed to line up. People were ducking under the barrier to cut into our line.
It was an amazing experience being up the Eiffel Tower but it could have been better.

It was great to hear about the Eiffel Tower and Paris while visiting it but there were some issues. First of all we ended up listening to a different tour group where the guide had much more information to give. In fact our group asked our guide if/when France paid back the investment of building the Eiffel tower and our tour guide’s answer was that the French are still paying to maintain it through taxes. On the tour we heard another guide (tour that gives attendees a pink sticker) ask the group to guess how long it took the builder to earn the building cost and the answer was 6 months! So, our tour guide wasn’t that knowledgeable.

The other issue was the lines cutting our tour short. The skip the line pass still took 30-45 minutes in line at the peak travel time (weekend afternoon at the end of July) and our guide had to cut our tour short to get to her next one as a result. They were not prepared to staff the high tourist times.

We arrived 15 minutes before our departure time and were handed over our entrance tickets to the Eiffel Tower. A tour guide took us to the Eiffel Tower on foot (which is hardly a 5 min walk). We queued at the security checkpoint and then for the lift. We skipped the queue for tickets which on the screens were showing to be 2 hour long.

First, at the foot of the Eiffel Tower, our guide exploaned the history of the tower. This was quite interactive and we learned interesting facts.

Next, on the second floor, our guide took us around and identified all the important landmarks and explained the history.

She was very nice and fun!

On the second floor, we said goodbye to our guide and took the lift to the summit.

Overall a great experience and would definitely recommend!

We had a few issues with this company…
Booked the tickets months ago and got a confirmation email saying we are good to go. Last month they sent me an email saying the tour won’t be possible at my selected time, and they can switch the times for the tickets. I didn’t notice this email until the day of the tour, so i called them but they didn’t even try to chase twice or refund me. On the call the operator said they’ve emailed me twice and I ignored them… which wasn’t the case as only one email was sent and they didn’t attempt to refund me just in case.

Second issue: our tour guide was quite young and a student, a super nice guy but we were given an expired ticket to go to the second floor. We lost half the group through security and thank god we stuck with him as we only were told our ticket is expired when we entered the queue for the elevator. He gave his apprentice ticket to us, but if he didn’t go with us, we would’ve been left without a ticket!!
These things should be checked way before given them out to customers who paid high prices for this “tour”.

Lastly, you don’t really skip the line much, we skipped half the first line and then queued for everything else. The guide told us 10 minute of information about some buildings we see on the second floor and that’s it, we were left on our own.

Buy your own tickets, stay a bit longer in the line and save money!! Not worth.

Meeting spot was unnecessarily far away. We spent a significant about of time waiting, defeating the purpose of purchasing tickets in advance. He never introduced himself other than saying, hi, I’m your guide. No name, ever. He just started walking and did not do a good job of explaining anything and we lost much of our group. Other than telling us about 2 security stops he did not explain much as we we waited in line in the rain for over n hour and then went up to the 2nd level. He also was not very loud, we could not hear him well. He did not say anything that I could not have read on a map myself. Weather was terrible, we could not see much. We were cold and very wet so we didn’t go to the top as a result. Very disappointing experience.

My. friend booked four tickets, paying $350 total, for this tour. She booked in July, two months in advance of our trip. On the evening of the trip, she arrived at the meeting point only to be told by the guide that he had given her tickets away and she could not go on the tour. Consequently, only two of us were able to go on the tour. A representative of the company refused to offer a refund. So beware: if you book with this company, your expensive tickets might not be available to you when you arrive. In twenty years of international travel, I have never encountered such an unethical tour company.

Despite arriving around the area 30 mins early and walking past the meeting point while asking anyone who look remotely like the tour guide like an idiot numerous times, we failed to identify the person. We then called the contact number for assistance, as indicated in the instructions, but we were told that it is our responsibility to locate the tour guide. No support was provided whatsoever. We asked if we can wait at the security check point instead (which everyone must get past anyways), but was told that they will not accommodate, nor can the contact number of the tour guide be provided to us. Also, there was no response by chat sent to the operator at the time. Long story short, the company consider this as late arrival and we missed our tour. No refund was given, and no further support was provided. Please do not bother with this tour or this company.

The Eiffel Tower lit at night and the views from the top level were amazing. Being able to bypass the lines was a very worthwhile benefit of this tour. However, all benefits stopped there. To start, our guide never introduced himself. He walked quickly not allowing members of our group to catch up prior to starting to point out facts about the Eiffel Tower or view. That actually did not matter that much because he was so soft spoken , it was difficult to understand him even when standing close. He only stayed with us to the 2nd level and then misdirected us to the elevator for gaining access to the top level.

We stood in the security line for at least 45 minutes ,as they kept letting other tours ahead of us. We finally got to the tower and were told that going to the top was not possible and we should receive a refund. We were only at the tower at a minimum of 15-20 minutes when they closed the tower. I requested a refund and was told we would only receive 10 euros per person. We paid 10 times that. We would never use this company for a tour again.

Zoey was a fantastic tour guide. She gave a great overview on the history of the Eiffel Tower and once we were at the second level she took us around and told us a little bit about the city. It wasn’t too long or too short, right to the point. Tickets also included summit access. Overall great experience and would recommend.

There are only 2 lines. For those with tickets and for those who need to buy a ticket. So you can buy online ticket on official site for 20 eur and you are in the same line as if you buy ticket for this tour.
I have to to add that our toir guide was very good and sympatic and a whole experience was very nice.

Let me start by saying the Eiffel Tower itself is amazing...I must have taken over 100 photos from every angle. And we visited at night so the light show every hour was magical.

Although our tour guide was friendly and clearly knowledgable, we had too many people (25+) for him to manage and although we paid to skip the line we still waited for a half hour (in the bitter cold) to enter the venue.

Considering this was one of our most expensive guided tours throughout our two week European visit, I question if this was worth it.

I felt like vip skipping the long line and walking straight through. once at the top it was beautiful and our tour guide gave us much info on the city and individual buildings. the top was very very busy but what do you expect. just be prepared for long lines to get to the bottom!

Zoe was wonderfully personable, kind and knowledgeable! She patiently shepherded us through the maze of lines quickly and effortlessly. It is apparent she likes people as she made us all feel welcomed and at ease. And the experience of seeing Paris from the tower was magnificent! Definitely the highlight of our trip!

We're giving this 5 stars because the experience was wonderful. The tour was pointless. Obviously, you pay the $80.00 to avoid the lines. Our appointment was at 10:30 PM and there was no line even though it was a beautiful night in late June. It's up to you whether or not it is worth it to pay for the tour. The guide was great and very friendly. He did his best to convey some information but, truthfully, five minutes on Wikipedia will give you all the information he shared with us. There ARE places in Paris that benefit from having a skip-the-line guided tour but, frankly, the Eiffel Tower doesn't really need it.

Absolutely amazing! The tour guide was Victoria.. probably didn't spell that right and I apologize, she was very informative and very funny and helpful. 10/10 highly, highly recommend.. an absolute stunning view of France and also it was amazing time because the lightshow started while we were on the Eiffel tower so it was an absolutely breathtaking moment.

Be careful .. we missed out on our tour as the email has a download your ‘ticket’ at the top which appears with a bar code, we did and and then added the ‘ticket’ to Apple wallet, only to find on arrival it’s not your ticket at all and can’t be scanned. If you scroll further down the mail it instructs you to go to another address, not the Eiffel Tower itself, to meet your guide when your ticket is given to you ! Frankly an idiotic way of presenting the email .. it should state in bold ‘do not go to the Eiffel Tower go to xxxx address’. To add insult to injury they refused to refund the price ..

First you cancelled my Eiffel Tower twice and then gave us 9am. We could not get a taxi or a bus from hotel to get there at 9am. So we never made it up to the top. I feel I paid for nothing and mostly because you canceled and change times knowing we couldn’t make it

When I met the tour guide he did not have me on the list. I showed him my ticket which said 8:00 pm and explained I received a message from this company stating the start time was delayed.
The tour guide had no communication about this change
Thankfully, they accommodated us
Then once we got to the tower , we were told the 3 rd floor was closed, this was disappointing however , technical difficulties happen
Overall, the tour was great , but communication with City Wonders and Viatar was poor

Originally purchased these as unable to gain summit tickets on the Official Website,
raised suspicions of agents bulk purchasing and selling on at twice the price !!
Thankfully, pleasantly surprised, the promotion did what it said on the tin,
We were met by the Guide "Max" at the designated time, and entered the tower relatively que free. Max spent almost an hour on level 2 educating our party on the historic surrounding sights and their history, something that was appreciated and knowledge you would certainly not be aware of if going it alone, so was both humorous and educational. Thank you Max, and well done !

We booked this the day before whilst we were in Paris. We were not disappointed. Our your guide was fabulous, he was very welcoming and friendly when greeting us. He was very informative and made us feel comfortable to ask questions and very relaxed. I would definitely book again.

Not completely as described. In the listing it says small group - up to 20 ppl. Well, ours had almost twice that many. There was a huge group of 16, plus about 5-6 families of 2 to 5 ppl each. The tour guide Jade did well, she was nice and tried to keep it fun. Most of the time though was spent on keeping the huge group together and making sure we got on the line and elevator etc. Honestly, knowing what I know now, we would have been better off going on our own with skip the line tickets. Not worth the price with the guide. Also, if you want to climb to the summit, you do that on your own anyway, The guide leaves you at the 2nd floor.
Huge line to get elevators to the summit. Lovely view from up top. So glad we did it. Best part? We climbed down the stairs all the way down from 2nd floor.

We had a hiccup at the check in station. When we arrived at the 2nd station, we were denied entry because we had a bottle of wine in our possession. Security would not allowed us in, so I told my friend to go instead and I would have to exit the Eiffel tower premise immediately. She had an opportunity to view the private tour we paid without me. If we would have known in advanced we would have never purchased the wine as souvenirs. Needless to say we could not enjoy the view together. Kind of disappointed. I even begged them to watch the bottle of wine, but they said they are not allowed. We would have to garbage the wine and that was not going to happen on my watch. I wished they had a locker we could have purchased and leave our possession in there. Maybe they should invest in it. My wine made it home safe but I did not tour with my group in the Effie’s tower.

Very bad communication. They said they changed the meeting time to 9:15pm from 9:30pm but the tour started at 9:00pm. We arrived at 9:05pm. They said they sent us an email about the time change but we never received one. They said they would not give us a refund even thought we were there before we were supposed to. I would stay away from this tour.

Was told when we got there that we could not go to the top and that a refund would be given to us. Only allowed to go to 2nd level, bit paid for full tour of the top. No one could tell us why, just said a refund would be given

Tour was simple and to the point. Meeting point is in front of a souvenir shop next to restaurant on street corner. The group meets here. Your ticket numbers are exchanged at this meeting point for the actual entry tickets. Tour guide was very good. Spoke French, English, and Spanish. Was worth the money and I would recommend, to move through the lines efficiently and not waste time, and get some historical information. Felt satisfied. You get in and follow a guide in a small group and stay together. I felt was a good value. You have to follow the group. and keep pace, after the tour is complete. You are free to roam at your own pace on the grounds. It is a good balance of price and tour. I give it five stars, in relation to what I paid, I feel like it was a good value.

The meeting location was easy to find although not completely clear on who the tour guide was. She could have used a paddle like other tours to identify herself. The access into the Eiffel Tower still involved standing in line but the wait time was reasonable. The summit elevator took about the same amount of time (20 min or so). Overall we were pleased with the event.

Terrible, couldn't find the location and they were gone before our scheduled time. NOT TO MENTION the eiffel tower only cost $18-$30 bucks a person, this orginization is GROSSLY overcharging its customers. DO NOT GET. And, do not use trip advisor, they will not help you whatsoever.

We were met at the advertised time and place by our guide and went straight past the queues, which were humungous. It saved us at least 45 minutes of waiting. Our guide was pleasant and knowledgeable and the whole tour lasted around 30 minutes. After that, we headed to the very top. You still have to queue for the summit elevators - our wait was around 5 minutes. Elevators to the top are transparent- NOT for the faint hearted. The views are absolutely worth it however 👍

Magnificent view, yet, overpriced tour cost. A copy of the provided entry ticket stated a cost of under EUR30 while we paid over USD80 for each ticket. Anyway, Eiffel Tower is a must to see landmark in Paris.

The summit was closed so the tour we paid for $500+ was not available .The tour operator replaced the tour to “second floor access by the elevator” We have done that in the past and were not interested in doing it again. Can not get a refund !!! The tour operator said we need to deal with Tripadvoser . Which is not possible - any link associated with the tour takes you back to the operator!
Yes, the refund policy is “ not refundable” … but not when the tour you purchased is not available because of some technical issues

Will avoid using Tripadviser . By the way if you go direct to the Eiffel Tour website - the price is a quarter if that.

Our guide Hugo could have not shown less interest in this tour. He raced through quickly, appeared to want to get out as quickly as possible. He lost track of his group frequently, but raced on. He was flip flopping between English and Portuguese, so it was very hard to follow what he was saying. It was a cold and windy day, but left his group frequently outside when other tour guides brought their group indoors for the narration. Worst tour guide we have experienced.

Although we were late due to a scheduling conflict, we were still able to complete our tour at a later time. The number we dialed was hard to reach and all in French. The employees at the Eiffel Tower spoke on the phone for us and relayed the later time. So I wouldn't rate the service on the phone a 5/5 but a 0/5. You can't contact your actual tour guide to relay any complications during your journey to the meeting point which would be super helpful like in our situation. But I don't fault the tour guide for this. They were great and entertaining

It was a great tour. Easy to check-in. The tour guide just stands outside of the gift shops at the assigned address, which is a block walk to the Eiffel Tower. It would be easy to do by yourself as well. If you want more information the tour will give you that little extra.

Our tour guide did an excellent job pointing out the sites and giving some history and background information from each of the four sides of the tower. Don't miss the summit! Our tour was perfectly timed at 20:00 for the sunset. We were prepared for pickpockets and an attempt was made but nothing was taken. Be aware of your surroundings.

Extremely poor communication. Metro was 25 minutes late and we were six minutes late to meeting place, which was "in front of a Souvenir store." We tried to contact the tour operator but they were not open. When we arrived at the "meeting place" there was no group and the store had no information. We then raced to the Eiffel Tower and tried to find the group. We were told that the "Summit was closed." We have requested a refund which we have been told we cannot get.

Started 10 minutes late. Got to the tower and tour guide had the wrong vouchers so we had to wait another 20/25 minutes for the correct vouchers. By this time the sun was down. I picked this time for specific sunset pictures.Got to the 2nd floor where the guide talked for only about 15/20 minutes. Not much information given. Then this skip the line tour stopped and we were left on our own to go to the top.

Excellent tour with Emma. She was very knowledgeable and fun. It was easy to meet up with the group at the appointed location and walk to the tower together. From there the line was short and the elevators did not have long waits either. She explained the history of the tower as we made our way up and then spent time with us at the top pointing out all of the major sights below in all directions. She was very easy to understand and made the experience great!

We had a lovely tour guide Blanche, she was insightful, helpful and funny. I added the Seine River Cruise--kind of worthless since we couldn't use all the tickets. The lines were so long (2-3 hours) of waiting, these are individual tickets and groups have priority so it nearly impossible to use unless you got there at 10 AM. Unless you are there when it's slow season, I don't recommend the additional river cruise.

We paid a lot of additional fees for the tour. Our tour guide told us that he was a student and needed to get home to study; therefore, he would tell us things on the second level and then he had to leave. We were free to go to the top of the Eiffel Tower on our own. We also had to stand in a long line to return to the ground level. Although the tour guide was nice, the details presented to us were minimal at best. I would not recommend this tour.

We were met by two young women at the specified group location and they quickly validated our tickets and organized us for the short walk to the tower. They helped manage us through all the correct lines and security and shepherded us up to the access lifts. Once we were all set on the second level we were left to wander at will which we really liked rather than be on somebody else’s schedule. We saw various people from our tour group throughout the next couple hours as all of us wandered according to our own interests. So, it isn’t exactly a tour, but well worth the cost of the ticket for the very helpful quickest possible entry among huge crowds. Highly recommended!

Our tour guide pushed me away when I tried to show proof of purchase. She had too many people on the tour, didn’t get back to me and print my tickets, therefore we missed our tour and they refused a refund.
We followed her all the way to the tower for her to send us back due to her incompetence. She stated we could get a refund which was denied when we got back to the meeting point.
None of the employees wanted to solve our issue and given that it was due to their inability to do their job correctly, a refund should be acceptable.

The Tower is an amazing thing to see. The lines were far worse than any TSA lines that I've been through and I've been all over the planet and in some really bad lines. The tour says that you skip the line here. Not true. Your group gets in line with everyone else and the group was so large that we didn't all fit on the elevator and got split up. I never saw the guide after we left the ground. There are 25 min lines at every level and it was packed like sardines in the elevators and on the platforms.When you're ready to go down, it's the same lines in reverse. Not worth the time or money. Do it yourself or look from the ground. If you're claustrophobic don't do it

We had a very friendly and knowledgeable guide, Matt. He explained a lot of history. We were very happy to skip the line as it extended all the way to the river, over 1 km long. We went in early October 2022. I recommend pre booking tickets for popular events! Everything went as explained. We met at a spot near the tower and went from there. It was effortless. I was a very positive experience!

Refunds and be honest with the real price of the Tower. Tickets at the tower itself are 27, way cheaper. The "skip the line" only really works for super crowded days. I would try going to tower first before using this service as it is a tourist trap in my opinion.

Paris in general has one flaw only: gigantic, exhausting queuing to anything: either Disneyland rides or Eiffel Tower - you waste incredible amount of time and patience on them (we are talking hours!) unless you have fastpasses/ skip the line tickets. Book them well in advance so it’s cheaper.
The particular service was excellent: our guide George was as handsome and tall as professional, pleasant, knowledgeable and totally on time! My son (11 y o) loved it!

We had a really great experience with Hafid today. He was very knowledgeable of the history of the Eiffel Tower and its engineers and builders. It was a nice touch to take a group picture and he was happy to take individual pictures for each of us. His follow up email included links and tips on other activities beyond the tour.

The lines weren’t that long, at the time of night, my grown son and I went but I’m sure that the lines were ridiculous, earlier, that day or any day. Access to the summit was quick and easy, not sure if it was because of our ticket but that made it worth the price. Our guide was knowledgeable enough to tell others what they probably didn’t know but this wasn’t my first trip to Paris. So the questions I had, he wasn’t sure about. But he was friendly, very personable and didn’t mind taking and even volunteered to take pictures of people with their phones/cameras for their memories.

Super good. We were worried after reading some reviews but you don’t need to be, make sure you meet the tour guide at the address given don’t assume it’s the Eiffel Tower and it’ll all run smoothly. The tour guides were amazing super laid back stay with them and learn a bit about what you’re looking at or go off on your own once up there. Would def recommended. ⭐️

I really enjoyed the access to all of the floors. Even though the view doesn’t change too much from the second tier to the third tier, it was a unique experience that I feel like is quintessential to the Paris experience. Our tour guide, Alex was great and did a nice job of pointing out the different Parisian landmarks and describing the Eiffel tower’s history while dropping some jokes in. Would definitely recommend for a seamless and enjoyable experience at the Eiffel Tower!

Well worth booking skip the queue ,although finding the meeting point took a little longer than expected.The tour guide was extremely efficient and very friendly. The tour and security ran very smoothly and was a must for a trip to Paris.The champagne and macaroons were an added bonus.

Remy was a knowledgeable tour guide who knew his English, history of Paris and the Eiffel Tower. He took us to the second level and left us there to continue to the top.. several in the group commented that we wished he ascended to the top with us to point out the buildings and sites we were seeing from the top.

It was an awesome experience to visit the Eiffel tower. The only draw back was the information they provided, they said we should have health pass, but local pharmacy told us don't need to, otherwise will cost extra. They should update to current information.

We had a great tour. The meeting place was easy to find and once the very large group got there the staff made sure that we remained organized and that everyone got their ticket to get in. Once we got in our guide, a young French guy, was fun and knowledgeable and told us a lot about France and the Tower itself. I definitly recommend this company.

This was a small group tour, it was only two families of 4. We met our guide and then walked in to the security check points and were in and up the elevator to the 2nd floor in less than 15 minutes. It was great to walk past all the long lines. There was a 25 minute guided tour with some history given, then we were shown where to catch the elevator to the top. Everyone has to wait for the elevator to the top, but that took about 15 minutes as it was a light afternoon.

Guide was disorganized and not clear on instructions. She had us go through thr security line and we didn't see her on the other side. We didnt know what to do so we kept going and got in the 430 line for the lift to 2nd floor. She saw us about 5 minutes later and yelled across the line and said "why did u guys go ahead". We said we didn't know what to do so we kept going. She yelled "too bad for u guys" and left. We never saw her again. There was another family of four in the tour that was next to us and they were confused where to go also.

Very enjoyable and informative tour through Eiffel Tower! Michael was excellent and remained collected while keeping our group together, even in the most chaotic areas. He pointed out all the important monuments while giving us background information and history, as well as a few fun facts.
Our family really enjoyed our time visiting, be sure to stop for a macron and champagne while you are up there.

It’s the Eiffel Tower, what can you say. It’s glorious... but if you can choose, go on any day but a foggy one, like me. Unfortunately I got the tickets a week or so earlier and didn’t know until that morning it was going to be so foggy (weather changes here quickly), but it was a wonderful and interesting time. Tour guide could not show or tell us anything of the sights so she ended up saying goodbye very early in the tour.

This was a great way to visit this site a not spend the entire day in line. Our guide was an American studying at the Sorbonne. I can’t remember his name, it was a Korean name I don’t want to mis-spell). He was wonderful , but only five us stayed with him for his talk on the history and what landmarks could be seen. He did a great job.

Our guide, Nick, is very knowledgable and quite funny. Despite all the rain and gusty wind when we arrived to the second floor, Nick stood in the rain and diligently explained the history of each of many iconic structures in Paris. He made the tour worthwhile. We were also quite pleased with the office at Fat Tire, clean, organized and convenient.

Ilona was personable and knowledgeable.
She snapped an amazing photo of my family next to the Eiffel Tower!
Unfortunately, the top of the tower was closed due to wind.
Also, it started to rain very hard once we got inside the tower.

This truly was a skip the line tour! Although we didn't get to skip the security line it was shorter and easier. Once that was done there was a very short line for the elevators. Our guide gave us lots of information about the Tower and the sights around us. She let us know about all the other things to do at the Tower and then we were on our own which was great. Plan to spend more than 90 minutes so you can linger on the tower and take in the snacks, shops, lounging and views.

Don’t waste your time. Too easy to just show up and purchase a ticket. By “guided” I thought that meant we were going to get the history or some facts however the guide lost us at the first floor never to be seen again.

I’ve always wanted to go to the Eiffel Tower. And the tour guide made everything so much better. Shout out to Bayo. He was so funny, and made the whole experience a lot of fun. I liked getting to know everyone in the group, it made the trip more personalized. We climbed up the stairs to the second floor, which I would totally recommend, I liked the stairs better than the elevator. Then we took the elevator to the top. The summit view is totally worth the extra cost. It is absolutely gorgeous, and we saw the cutest couple get engaged. I am afraid of heights, but everything was really safe and I didn’t find it frighting. It was totally worth it. I loved the tour, and the people I meet were super cool.

Great guided tour by Pascal , really interesting and really informative. The Adults and the teens both really enjoyed this and the whole experience Was amazing .
Instructions for meeting points etc all very clear and everything ran smoothly .
Would definitely recommend

I recently did the Eiffel Tower tour with a small group of what was mostly Americans. While it’s not necessary to have a guide for this type of attraction, ours provided a lot of detail on the history of the structure as well as information on all the buildings in Paris that you can see from the observation decks. This is a must see for any Paris visitor.

We had booked this tour with another couple. We received separate emails from Trip Advisor that our booking was cancelled and offered another time. We rescheduled to the new time, but our friends were unable to and eventually were given the original time back. We tried to return to the original time also and got a message that it was unavailable. They cancelled and we went (and the tour was fine) but it ruined the experience that we had planned because it disrupted the whole day.

Better communication from tour company. Complete waste of money. Waited for 25+ minutes and did not know our tour guide was within the crowd but did not introduce herself. Was almost left without our ticket if I hadn’t asked for one. Not worth it.

Alex was superb. He stayed with us until the end (second level). Really know how to excel in his job.
We went to the summit without him because it was a long line just a brief experience on top of the Eiffel.
Small note: Skip the line is only up to the second floor not the summit.

First time in Paris and had to do this tour. Our tour guide was an amazing young Parisen who was very knowledgeable which was great as we didn't know much.
Only queue we really had to wait in was security which did take a little while, but to be expected.
We were up to the summit no problem, was an amazing experience.
We had a flight to catch so couldn't stay long but would definitely do this tour again hopefully with more time to spend enjoying the awesome views.

My wife and I took this tour, booked mostly for the importance of the skip the line part. The added bonus was a really fun and knowledgeable guide that really enhanced the tour for us. Her insight provided lots of history and color that really made this tour even more interesting. Very well done.

Really recommend doing this tour when visiting Paris! Was extremely easy to go through security and skip the queues with the guide. The tour was extremely interesting and didn’t last too long, meaning we had lots of time to explore by ourselves. The tour guide Emma was really welcoming and helpful!

This has been the worst experience of my life. I booked for the guided tour with summit access through your website (tickets attached). Got to the meeting point early and met your guide too. My husband and I came with him and the group to the Eiffel Tower. Post the first security check and right before the entry we’re told that we don’t have tickets!

When we ask your guid to help us, he says they’ve run out of tickets. Everyone else in the group got the tickets. Even people that arrived late! - except us.

The guide then gave us 2nd floor tickets and left us alone. Now we are buying top floor tickets ourselves. Paying for the whole thing again and no guide too as we were not taken with the tour - WHICH WE PAID FOR.

Let me know the clear reason?? Is it our fault? Why were we treated like this and no one else.

Mon Petit has been the worst experience of our lives. We feel cheated!

You only partially skip the first queue. You then have to wait in the long lines for the next three! The guide was two weeks into the job and a student. He knew very little and got some of the dates and facts wrong, although a nice person - he didn’t care about how much we paid - which was twice than the normal ticket! Avoid, it is a scam!

Our tour guide was friendly and knowledgeable. He was able to get us in quickly and took us to every side of level 2 and pointed out the various sites from there. Then we were able to ascend and see the city of lights at night...Breathtaking!

Do not buy this!!! We paid 300$ and they “ran out of tickets”. The tour guides response was the company sucks but I need a job. We did not get into Eiffel Tower even though it was the goal of the trip with mother and daughter

Great way to enter the Eiffel Tower and skipping the line. There is still a security line but it’s not that bad- expected at a major landmark like this. The guide is knowledgeable and friendly and added a nice touch to the experience. The second floor is still very high but this does not include the summit which was also great.

Absolutely bad . The tour guide was bad I’ve booked tickets weeks ago . But when I met the guide she said the tour company had a problem with the tickets. I would never use this company again. I had to pay for new tickets for my girlfriends birthday present.

Eiffel Tower itself is truly a wonderful impressive sight. But the skip the line simply Dosent work, we still joined the back of the existing line as only one elevator working. Meaning the extra we paid gave no benefit. Also worth noting it was never part of the plan to slip the line on the way back down, meaning we also waited there too. By all means go and the see this wonderful attraction, but don’t bother paying the extra for skip the line.

You booked us on a tour that was full already. You failed to check with them to see if there were any openings at the date and time we choose. You owe me a full refund for your failure, not mine. Please put the money back on my Credit card.

We followed all the instructions to meet at a spot away from the Eiffel Tower..which is strange to begin with. The guide gave us our tickets at that spot and we preceded to the tower. Then, during the security gate process, our line was slow and when we got out, the guide and rest of group were gone! Wouldn’t the guide do a count before he left that area??!! We had to wait in the standard line and never saw the guide or group the rest of the night. And to top it off..no refund afterward. Total rip-off!!!

Really good tour led by BB. Easy to get to the meeting point and everything was well organized.

Skip the line tickets were definitely worth it on this tour. We went through a separate entrance and saved a lot of time not waiting in line. BB was fun and very knowledgeable. We had a nice evening view of Paris with good weather and clear skies. We spotted our hotel from the summit as my wife had champagne and macarons on the summit! Our son (21) enjoyed it as well.

Well worth it for my wife and son's first trip to Paris.

Went on a group visit with Maarten the guide. He kept up an excellent commentary which was witty, fast paced and fascinating. The tower itself is amazing but even better when accompanied with Maartens facts. Thoroughly recommended.

What an amazing experience! We got to go all the way top of the tower to see amazing views. However, what really sold this experience was the guide. He was not only knowledgeable, but funny and personable too. Able to answer all of our questions and make us laugh and engage too! Not to mention he was great with the children that were with us! 5/5 experience would highly recommend.

Tour was canceled due to strike and we could not reschedule. We are so sad. Wish we had someone to call to reschedule. Please give us a phone number. October 8th would be a great day as we will still be here. Please help us. We know you can't control strikes but you might be able to help us reschedule .

Very well organised tour. ALIX our guide was fantastic from start to finish. She was enthusiastic and informative throughout the tour. We thoroughly enjoyed our tour and would highly recommend this trip. Thank you Alix!

Guide never showed up.We booked the tickets thru trip advisor for dec 31st at 9:30 pm..We waited for 1 hour and no one showed up.No emails abt cancellations too..I have sent so many messages regarding refund but no reply.

It was a great experience. The tour guide was quiet knowledgeable and well versed in Parisian history. Also able to speak 3 languages fluently which is definitely a plus for tourist. Our group was able to breeze through security and get the the 2nd floor in great time. Highly recommended.

Fantastic! Even better if you make it to the top shortly before sunset. This also gives you the opportunity to have dinner right next to the departure point before taking the tour.

Our guide was informative and fun and she took good care of us.

From outside gorgeous. From inside, not worth it. Long cues and crowds of people and, well, the view, if you are lucky enought to see it, is beautiful. But is not a view you can't get from anywere else.

I suggest to visit it only from the outside and save some time.

Still and so it is a classic that no one can miss if you're close by Paris.

Booked in advance so some queuing. Booked to the first and second floor. Very good view on the second across Paris.Lifts busy but well managed. Excellent souvenir shop where we were given a free cloth "Paris" bag!
Cafe not too busy but fairly expensive. Saw Kate Garraway though who said "hello" and was very friendly so worth it!
Very good day out and easy to access from our hotel nearby.

Visited here on 11th March. Had great tour guide Maxime who was very knowledgeable. Small group which was better as able to ask questions. Quick admission and worth the extra to skip the queue.Tower itself is amazing with fantastic views from all floors. Highly recommend for all ages.

It was a little confusing at first, as the three guides didn’t seem to have their agenda aligned. We were able to jump ahead of the security check-in and again at the ticket line which saved A LOT of time. Don’t get me wrong, there is still plenty of waiting in line (you wait for the elevator to the second floor and again to go to the summit) but we definitely saved time with this tour.

Remi was a wonderful guide for us. Very knowledgeable. His English was especially good! The whole experience of going to the top of the tower was a thrill. So glad we did it. Do plan to wait in lines for the elevators up and down - but you don’t have to wait to get to that point. Very busy and popular tourist attraction.

What a wonderful experience!! We thought we were just buying tickets to the top of the Eiffel Tower. We had no idea we’d be blessed with Carol for the morning to guide us around. She was awesome - the kids loved her too. I highly recommend this!

We're so glad we signed up with this tour to experience the Eiffel Tower! We had little wait and access to the summit. Our tour guide was delightful and knowledgeable of the panorama the Tower provides. A sip of champagne and a macaron from the summit at night made for a perfect end of the day.

Our guide was very knowledgeable and to the point about this landmark. His English was great and spoke with an American accept unless saying special names of French landmarks and the. Could pronounce them correctly. The picture he took of my friend and I in front of the tower using our phones was worth the cost of the tour.

We booked the tour to go to the top of the tower through trip advisor. We met up with the guide fine however, when we got to the 2nd floor, the lift to the top was out of action due to wind. The guide on the day was great and he advised we would receive a refund on the element of the tour we didn’t receive. We followed the process and the tour company Mon Peru’s Paris advised that as the tour was arranged through TripAdvisor, I’d have to process this request through TripAdvisor. I have done this and as yet, they still haven’t even acknowledged my request.
Be careful!!!!

This is not a true skip the line tour. You meet your tour guide 2 blocks from the tower. Your group then walks over, and is directed to queue up in line for the lift. At our visit they were working on 1 lift, and the other lift was not working. We stood in line for over 2 hours to access the 2nd level. The tour guide didn’t share enough history on the tour, he focused on what you could see from the observation deck. This tour was not what I was looking for. Waste of time and money

If you would like to have fun and in the same time gain some knowledge about Effel tower, then this is a must. First you will skip the line, secondly you will definitely enjoy the sence of humor and lastly gather more information about the tower. Thank you for the wonderful experience. Our tour guide was a gentlemen.

Essentially you are paying for group "expedited" access to the second level and elevator use (not expedited) to the top level. The guide provided no educational information regarding the Eiffel Tower or Paris prior to reaching the second level (over 30 minutes into the "tour"). The tour consisted of approximately 30 minutes of pointing out landmarks from the second level. It was okay, not good enough to be considered average. The guide didn't seem too enthused; I would try a different tour company.

PLEASE READ THIS BEFORE PURCHASING FROM THIS COMPANY!!! This company sent our tickets to an email address we did not provide and that was disabled. Arriving early (about 8:30 pm) to the Eiffel Tower, we called them. By the time we got them on the phone, they could not or would not tell us where they sent the tickets, only that they would forward them to us at that time which was by then 9:15 and our tour was 9:00. DO NOT TRUST THIS COMPANY AND SERVICE.

This a total scam
No skip the line option they are just purely scamming
The tour guide will pretend to be chocked and surprised when the tour personal are saying that the "skip the line" option does not exist
This should not be allowed on trip advisor cause it is a squeam to steel money

Let’s just say this purchase is to skip the line on the entrance to the Effiel Tower. This doesn’t allow you to skip any lines while in the Effiel Tower. I don’t recommend this, also they have no wheelchairs for rental. The Champagne bar is a Kiosk ~ overall nice view.

View was nice even with the smog layer that engulfs Paris. Still a long wait even with skipping the normal line... Lots and lots of people crammed in everywhere. I think I would of rather spent the 4 hours in a nice restaurant/bar with view of the Tower instead of going up it.... would not do a second time..

Grabbed this "deal" because I could not obtain tickets to the summit through the Eiffel Tower website. Wanted my granddaughter to experience the summit, so agreed to pay three times as much as I would have through the Eiffel Tower site. Meet up was fine, and the guides divided the group into two. Walked across the street to a spot near the Tower, and the guide offered a meager amount of information. He then led the large group through security without any warning about where we were headed and what to do if we got separated. A dozen or so of us in the back did get separated, but found them at one of the elevators. Again, there was no information given during a long wait through security. The elevator filled and doors closed on us and many others in the group When we reached the second floor, they were nowhere to be seen. The three of us headed to the summit and finished our "tour" on our own, never seeing the group again. This is clearly a way to gouge tourists like myself who were not able to obtain tickets to the summit. There was no attempt to keep the group intact (holding up a sign maybe?). I did get to the summit, but would never use tripadvisor again.
Nothing wrong with the tour company. But overall a disastrous trip as France has poor control and openly racist.

First, we met just slightly offsite with the group. This is by design, and a good idea. The tour guide spoke great English which was great. Only downside....he was loaded with cheesy jokes. He told us how it would go and it executed flawlessly. Fun time. We chose to break away from the tour and go to the summit to expedite our time. It’s about a 1 minute ride to the top. They do pack the elevators quite full. Once at the top, the view is simply amazing, especially at night. I am very glad we chose to experience at night instead of during the day. Excellent trip. Beware of the Gypsies that ask “Do you speak English”. It’s their ploy to get you talking to them. Additionally, upon entry and exit, there a sever street vendors. A polite “no” with ward them off. The guide did advise of pick pocketing. We had no issue and always felt safe. That said....keep your head in a swivel and be aware of your surroundings and all will be fine. DO the “skip the line tickets” as it really saves time.
Alex was just the best!! He is extremely knowledgeable as well as entertaining! The tour ran smoothly and our group was great!! Five stars for sure!!

This tour was excellent! The views were spectacular and our guide was extremely informative and entertaining. He also managed a large group of us very well. I highly recommend this tour and securing your tickets ahead of time. The lines are much longer than they were years ago.

My teenage son and I took this tour in October 2019. I would not recommend this tour to anyone it is a complete waste of money. We paid over $300 and the only thing that we got was to enter in a separate line and quicker access to the elevators to the second floor. Our tour guide did not provide us with any tour type details, history of the tower etc. We hurried up to wait in line and once he got us all to the second floor he explained that they could go off on their own or he could show everyone around the second floor of the Eiffel tower. The tour guide then proceeded to point out about four sites in less than 10 minutes and then told us that was the end of the tour and left us on the second floor. We took a similar tour two years ago with another company and it was absolutely phenomenal that’s why we decided to take another tour again on this trip. The only Value is the skip the line part, but that is never worth over $350. Find another company and read the reviews.

I do NOT recommend. We waited in line for almost an hour and NEVER moved. The tour guide said it was the shortest line:(. When we asked about the skip the line, he said this is “it”. We did not get to tour.

We had the opportunity to be Alexandria’s first group as a tour. We really appreciated her advice and commentary about the Eiffel Tower and other points of interest. The tour starts at a convenient meeting place just minutes from the Tower. We entered through the reserved gate, bypassing several hundred people waiting to purchase tickets. After going through two security checks, required and understandable, we rode the elevator to the second level. Alexandria provided an overview of Paris from each side, including the history of Paris from Roman times to the present.

Our tour concluded in the second level, but our ticket gave us access to the elevator for a ride to the summit. Amazing views and we consider this tour to be the best one we have had in a long time. Well worth the cost!

If you are going, please help the single couples or families by offering to take a picture of them together. It will be greatly appreciated and they will reciprocate. Also, have fun and take some fun shots as well, especially at the kissing point.

This was a brilliant tour, our guide was amazing, he was comical but very knowledgeable. He was able to answer everyone's questions and made the whole experience more enjoyable. The meeting point was easily enough to find (using a mobile phone and Google maps) we arrived 25minites early, just to make sure we weren't refused and our guide Alex was there ready and waiting. I would really recommend this trip and if you get Alex then that's a bonus.
The queue to the summit wasn't as bad as I had read about, I think we queued for about 35 minutes, but you're constantly moving so doesn't feel that long. Finally when you get to the top, you must have champagne, yes 18€ for a 10cl may seem expensive but hay how often do you go up the Eiffel tower and sip champagne?
Overall 100% recommend!

I grew up in NYC and worked in the Empire State Building but was so enamored by this experience! The tour guide was great! I enjoyed the over priced flute of Rose'. I missed it at night but as thankful that the sky was clear. Definitely thought it was worth the expense to skip the line and hear the history from the tour guide!

I had to cancel the trip and send two emails to the Eiffel Tower to see if I could get a voucher or transfer the booking to SEPTEMBER 10th as I have booked that date now. I had a reply from the Eiffel Tower to say they would get back to me as soon as possible but I had no reply

Very knowledgable tour guide and skip the line was fantastic again.
Really enjoyed the experience.
The only downside was how busy it was - you were crammed in to the lifts like sardines.
We waited to go up to the summit as well - when we got there it was so busy that all you could do was a quick lap around and then start the descent.

Loved the experience and being able to say I’d done it - just wish it was less rushed and full.

Maybe picking the most romantic day to spend in Paris might have been to blame.

All this said - I’d definitely go back and do it all again - maybe on a night to experience all the twinkly lights.
They stole my money. Would never recommend this group of crooks. Beware!!!!! These people can not be trusted.

It really wasn't a line skip to me. However it was a good buy. It was a small tour with a tour guy who in which was great, funny and a handsome young man that gave us information on the Eiffel Towers history. I recommend going at night. It's beautiful and a amazing experience.

Just wow!!!

Tour guide: Adrien (hope I spelt that correctly)

There is nothing more frustrating than looking for a place to meet and not knowing anyone there or what language they speak. This - however - was NOT the case thanks to our tour guide Adrien!!!

Very quickly he made us all feel relaxed with his open welcoming demeanor and friendly way. Preparing us and making sure we know what to expect he got us going in no time and without rushing us took step-by-step up the Eiffel Tour.

His knowledge and experience showed at every turn and hence why I can only say WOW!!!

This is most certainly an adventure you must take. Skipping the line is a must and the views, information and words excitement were fun...

Thanks to this tour we made a new friend who we are meeting up with to plan a trip somewhere in the world...

Truly creating memories and adventures...

To the team and of course Adrien 'Trés trés magnifique!!!'

Merci beaucoup...

Excellent and worth the money to summit the Eiffel Tower! Easy to find just look for a group of people in front of two souvenir shops! We were big group that evening but the Eiffel Tower at night is a must! The lights are amazing!

The only fault of this excursion was the being unorganized at the beginning. Otherwise our tour guide was excellent, Matthew, and he provided history as well as fun facts about Paris in general. We went at 8 pm and the lights around the city were beautiful. I would highly recommend a night tour!

It is the Eiffel Tower.... can't mess that up.
Tour guide was knowledgable and showed us great photo ops.

Highly recommend and go early.
Stairs down beat the elevator.

Received our tickets from the tour guide down street. Matt our guide was good and due to a breakdown we had to fall in line but Matt arranged for us to skip the line! Wonderful experience, enjoyed doing it at night was really cold though. Highly recommended.
Great tour and well done for the team, especially Marie!!! We met outside of the tower and we walked all together receiving some amazing info about the tower itself.

Highly recommend this package. The tour guide was lovely, Alex, offering to take our pictures and was well humoured as well as very informative about the Eiffel Tower.
Very very high as expected, but wouldn’t have missed it for anything.

We made sure to meet up, on time at the right rendezvous spot (which was not easy to find in any of the correspondence).

Our tour was at 5pm, and the queue after security and showing our group tickets was maybe 30 minutes, whilst the queue to purchase tickets and then queue again was probably more than an hour.

Edouard was amusing and knowledgeable about the Eiffel Tower, it’s history and the sights that we could see. Recommend.
Arrived and guide already left. There was no way to get anyone to help. Tried to get in next tour and it depends if someone doesnt show up. NEVER AGAIN

While many say to get your Eiffel Tower tickets directly, Skip The Line Tour was worth the extra money, particularly if you don't speak French! Our guide Remy was excellent - not only preparing us to navigate through two security checkpoints but also providing a great overview of the history of and views from the Eiffel Tower.

Best time to go is hour and half before sunset. If you book 5:00pm you hit the elevator at 5:30. So plan accordingly. It’s hard to plan the timing on the summit ride. The lines can greatly vary in waits. If you have a choice between Eiffel Tower and Arc de Triomphe Because of limited time. Go to Arc De Triomphe . The Make France Great Again people want to call it Arc De Trump. Let’s make France great again. Hey for those who are upset with this comment. It’s a Joke. Learn to laugh again

This was a lot of fun. We went up the tower with Alex, our tour guide. We also had a skip the line tour so it was really fast with an elevator to take us up. We timed it so the sun would set while we were on the top. It was just about perfect. Alex was a great tour guide.

I highly recommend this tour. Since the Eiffel Tower is reported to be the most visited paid landmark in the world, the lines to visit this landmark will be long. We chose a transitional weather month (late October) to visit in the hopes of having to deal with less crowds. It worked. As the title of this tour suggests, your tour guide will get you right up to the 2nd floor and provide with a quick history of the surrounding landmarks within the hour. Then, you are on you own. This tour also provides you with tickets to climb (or take the elevator) to the top of the tower. Unfortunately, for us, we decided not to go to the top as the winds were too strong and the temperatures were quite cool that day that high up. No matter, we still enjoyed a wonderful afternoon visiting the Eiffel Tower and the surrounding park.

Our tour guide was a history buff who was not only able to point out the various areas of the city from the third level, but shared historical context. He was especially knowledgeable of the history of the Eiffel Tower itself and made the tour from ground level to the top quite a lot of fun. I recommend this 2-hour tour without reservation. It's a "must do" when in Paris.

Everything has changed around the Eiffel Tower. Lot's of security and lines. So it's worth the extra money to be able to quickly go though all this and start enjoying what you came to see. The Eiffel Tower. Great tour guide also, who pointed out several things we would have missed if we went by ourselves.

What a great buy. Met our tour guide Alex who was great fun and entertaining. Would advise anyone to book in advance with a guide to understand the view of Paris from the top. Long waits to get the elevator to the summit but well worth it.

Loved this tour! Our guide was informative and funny.
Would do this tour again! The views are fantastic. The history regarding building of Eiffel Tower amazing

The skipping of the line was the easiest and fastest way to reach the elevators to the 2nd level. Our group was small enough that we could all here Max and all the information that he had for us. His English was excellent. The trip itself is wonderful. As we walked around the first level (because it was less crowded) Max pointed out notable buildings, gardens, etc. and gave some additional information about what we were seeing. He did a great job for us and I had a wonderful time and highly recommend the experience.

There was NO skipping the line! Didn't get to the submit because of wind. Tour guide brushed of questioning that we waited in the normal line everyone else did. Finally said we will get a partial refund, but to email business and could take a while. Hope tripadvisor will provide quickly and take off this poorly represented tour company. Beyond disappointed!

On the day of our tour, one of the elevators were working. The guide attempted to get us ahead in the line but she did not have any influence with security. Our scheduled time was 1:30 and we were still waiting in line at 2:30. My husband and I walked up to the second floor and were able to go the summit easily from there. We paid for elevator access which we could not use. Several others had to do the same because they needed to get back for another tour.

A decent tour. We did get a few interesting new facts but had already heard much of the information provided through other tours. The helpful part was not having to stand in the ticket line for 2 hours, which was the estimated wait time when we arrived. It was a windy and rainy evening so there were no lines for the lift once we were in the tower.
Very knowledgeable, patient and personable guide who repeatedly went out of her way to make everyone feel comfortable
Gives an interesting guided tour till the 2nd floor and then guides you to the summit. Very good! Made it memorable. No queues required.

I booked on-line the skip the lines ticket. What is not clearly stated on the website is that the only line advantage is to the first level albeit with the guide. The guide then departed and I was then left to stand in the queue for 45 minutes to gain access to the summit.
The tour was exceptional and was definitely worth the money. Going to the top was so cool and we will remember it for many years to come.

We missed the tour due to a transport strike on Friday 13th September. I asked the tour operator for a refund and they declined, stating ‘the tour operated as planned’ There were no trains or buses running. We made every effort to get there. It took an hour for a taxis to arrive and we were charged $150 euro for a 8km trip that took an hour. Do not use this operator, choose one with a cancellation policy or one with reviews that demonstrate compassion. I’ll never visit Paris again.

Met the tour guide a couple blocks from the tower. Walked about 5 minutes to the tower and skipped the main line. Went through a couple security check points and then into the tower elevators. Having the guide direct us in the right direction helped to avoid confusion and delays. He gave a nice overview of the tower history and pointed out landmarks from the second level. We were on our own for the elevator ride to the top. Nice tour, just the right amount of time and information.

I don't like to write negative reviews. I prefer just to share experiences that I would like others to enjoy as much as I have. But I feel an obligation to share this experience as a "warning". This tour was a mess! The main problem . . . the young woman guiding the tour was not even close to being bilingual in French and English. My wife and I could not understand her at all, except for the words she added to the end of almost every sentence. "Eees okay?" And I suspect that we were not alone! Out of the nine or ten people who started out in our tour group, everyone but my wife and I, and one other couple, disappeared as soon as we got through the security check at the entry. We never saw any of them again. In short, this was a total waste of money. Except that we did get to "skip the line" getting in.

I expect that pre bought tickets are still quicker but we were in a line for showing these tickets to get in/through security. Another line to que fo our slot. another long line to get through another security into the base of the tower. Another line to get in the lift. and queing to get in each lift up and down.
We did go in August (on a friday). I think the skip the line title is incorrect but as i said, the no ticket que was bigger!
They also let too many people up at once. They are packing in the slots. we had to walk sideways on almost all the time in single file making it hard to enjoy the views together (which you had to wait to get a turn to do) and irritated tourists made this less enjoyable than imaigned. Avoid holiday periods where possible. A picnic on the grasses below with the eifffel as the backgroup would have been much more romantic/better use of time.

Marion was our guide and she was excellent. Her English was good and she was very knowledgeable about the sights that could be seen from the tower. She answered questions and clearly loves her city.
We recommend going up to the summit, it's incredible. Fantastic trip. A must do in Paris!

Yeah we had some better access, it wasn't THAT much faster but I still recommend it because you never know what you'll find when you get there. Our guide (who's name I'll put in when I find it) was GREAT. He told us more than I thought he would, was friendly and asked questions to keep us engaged. I highly recommend it
Excellent - highly recommend the tour - not only can you skip the line, but the tour guide provides an excellent overview of Paris.

We purchased these tickets as the official website had sold out and we were looking to wait as little as possible.
The tour left a little later than stated on our ticket but once at the Eiffel Tower we were able to skip the majority of the first line, which only allows you access into the area. After this, the tour was frustrating as we were held up waiting for all of our group as some members wanted or needed to visit the bathroom. The guide hung back waiting for those but told the rest of us to move forward into the elevator access area. Once here we were totally separated from our group as there are two elevators. Once we got out the elevator I had no idea where the guide was as it was busy. After looking for a short time we decided to just take the second elevator to the summit.

Overall the tour was a little disorganized. The value in the ticket was the faster access to the tower area and first level (although there are still considerable wait times).
A brief but informative tour on the second level followed by access to the summit. I've been before but not to the summit.

While this got us into the tower quickly not sure it saved much time. Our guide was below average and hard to understand. We eventually left her.

The tower is magnificent nonetheless

Ida was a Marvels tour Guide made sure we Stayed together . Explained the history of the Eiffel tower very interesting . Pointed out points of interest . Very knowledgeable enjoyed the experience thanks to her . Would Highly recommend this tour. Will recommend to all My Friends . thanks from Art n Liz 7 / 19

We had a fantastic tour. Alex was funny and very informative on our tour. We went to the summit. Lines were about 30 mins to the summit and 30 mins down. The difference in the view is minimal. If you are short on time skip the summit.

Leo was an amazing guide, full of energy, information, and great stories! He provided great information regarding the Eiffel Tower and Paris. Seeing the sunset from the summit was an amazing experience. Highly recommend!

Last day in Paris and up the Eiffel Tower I was dragged! :-) I'm not a fan of heights, but this was a once in a lifetime experience, right? So, with my wife and 18 year old daughter, we did the Eiffel Tower Tour and Summit visit. Niko was a great guide. He knew the history and his English was very easy to understand. His grade is excellent for his performance.
This was the way to go! We met at a meeting point close to the Eiffel Tower. Easy and worth it to skip the line. The guide was good too!
Awesome tour! Our tour guide was very informative and she was very funny! The view is spectacular! I would not recommend this for young children, but definitely for teens!

Very popular attraction for a very good reason. Expect very long lines and wait time if you don't go with Skip the Line. We saved about 2 hours of wait time, worth the extra cost as we were short on time. Best to go at night as they lights make this tower even more impressive and the views are majestic.

Don’t buy from them, not only do they NOT send you tickets, you are expected to arrive earlier n meet some guide slim front if a souvenir shop!!! Like we are tourist, we got lost n traffic was atrocious that day. They should hv sent us our tickets and meet at Eiffel Tower entrance. We wasted our money AND WILL NOT BE RECOMMENDING THEM.
We tried calling this # +33 1 79 75 80 00 which was on the booking form and it DID NOT WORK!!!
Waste of freaking money. My suggestion is just queue n buy tickets there. It isn’t as bad as one thinks.

In Paris the Eiffel Tower is a must do. It was a perfect day dry and sunny the views were awesome. Our tour guide was funny and excellent information. Can get very busy, it gives you a perfect overview of Paris the city well worth doing awesome views.

Great tour of the tower, and we got to skip the line! Our guide was were engaged and kept the tour interesting.

Remy, our tour guide, was a breath of fresh air with a great sense of humor and boundless energy. You meet in front of a souvenir shop close to the tower. DO NOT GO TO THE TOWER! Follow the directions on your order and you’ll be fine. We showed Remy our online order and he handed us two paper tickets, which you’ll need throughout the tour. After about 10 minutes in front of the shop, we walked across the street to the Tower. First security check where you empty your pockets and walk through a metal detector. Once through that check you get on an elevator to the 2nd floor where Remy tells you all about the sights you’re seeing below and answered many questions. He truly was a delight and we learned so much! Once Remy finishes his part of the tour you’re on your own. We went up to the Summit and looked at the country below. The summit is enclosed by the way, but the view is spectacular. Then headed down to the first floor for gift shop, wine at the restaurant and a different view now that we were closer to the ground. Every hour on the hour the tower “sparkles” with flashing lights, so be sure to get down in time to see it! All in all I’d say we spent about two hours there but had a wonderful time (my 19 year old daughter flew in to stay the weekend with me). Don’t stand in line like lemmings and take this tour! We learned so much and Remy, yep, he’s a keeper!!
